title: Figure 3.4: Dipole Reactor Propulsion Scheme (Dipole Assisted IEC, DaIEC)
description: Line schematic of the dipole-assisted IEC propulsion concept showing magnetic field lines pinched at a central dipole magnet (boxes with X marks) and fanning outward to both sides. Coil cross-sections are drawn above and below, with one labeled 'Stabilizing coil'. Accompanying text describes ions exiting to the right being trapped by the stabilizing coil field and exhausted to produce thrust.
